export_workflow.description: Use a video-only stream-copy input, generate every frame, then mux the original audio without -shortest; verify frame count and audio packets.

limitations: The upstream CLI does not automatically load this JSON; use the documented equivalent arguments.
Lip normalization changes the source-mouth baseline; it is not a tooth-detail restorer.
Small mouth openings may be suppressed; validate against the driving video.
No new weights or training; no general multi-identity quality guarantee.
